final:
-- One step of a Park-Miller style generator. Pure, so no capabilities.
next_state(s: int) -> int =
  pre s >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out < 2147483647
  ex next_state(1) == 48271
  (s * 48271) % 2147483647

-- Deterministic shuffle: the result depends only on xs and seed.
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([5], 3) == [5]
  var ys: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    ys.append(x)
  let n = xs.len()
  var state = seed % 2147483646 + 1
  for k in range(0, n - 1)
    let i = n - 1 - k
    state = next_state(state)
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    let a = ys[i]
    let b = ys[j]
    ys[i] = b
    ys[j] = a
  ys
